overview: The Community Development Board endorsed an ANR plan and approved site plans for a convenience store conversion on Main Street and a new commercial building on Mystic Avenue. The board continued hearings on the Tufts Aquatic Center and an inclusionary zoning amendment regarding fractional cash payments.

items.title: 73 Boston Ave and 94 Monument Street ANR Plan
items.summary: Endorsed an Approval Not Required plan adjusting the shared rear property line between 73 Boston Ave and 94 Monument Street.

items.title: 85 Main Street Site Plan Review
items.summary: Approved a site plan to convert a former gas station and repair shop into a convenience store with draft conditions regarding public way encroachments.

items.title: 130 College Ave (Tufts Aquatic Center) Site Plan Review
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to May 20 to allow Tufts to provide detailed elevation drawings, a comprehensive corridor streetscape plan, and resolved pedestrian safety and traffic-calming measures.

items.title: 161 Mystic Avenue Site Plan Review
items.summary: Approved the site plan and granted waivers for building story height and parking minimums for Lechmere Rug's new commercial building.

items.title: Zoning Amendment: Inclusionary Housing Fractional Payments
items.summary: Continued the public hearing to May 20 after staff reported that the state no longer publishes total development cost figures used to calculate fractional cash payments.

items.title: Approval of Minutes and Administrative Updates
items.summary: Approved meeting minutes from February and April and discussed upcoming joint meetings with the City Council regarding the Boston Avenue zoning proposal.
